# HyperFrames (HeyGen) — third-party material in RestorffCut

Source: https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes.git @ d63ff907aae9440e999610595c09adb2da189b7f (Apache-2.0; Copyright 2026 HeyGen, Inc.).
Copied by `tools/fx-sync` (adapter `hyperframes`). LICENSE and CREDITS.md are the upstream's, verbatim.

Every adapted file starts with `Adapted from <source> (<licence>) <path>@<commit>; modified`. Changes made to
each: a RestorffCut params block, the `<!-- rc-lib -->` marker instead of CDN scripts (GSAP itself is never
shipped: our MIT gsap-compat runtime replaces it), inline scripts deferred until fonts load, fonts localised
(OFL/Apache, `packages/compositions/fonts/gf/`), determinism fixes (no will-change / CSS transitions /
translate3d with z = 0; Math.random seeded), the source's own name in example copy replaced with fictional
Halcyon text, brand-named ids renamed generically, brand logos replaced by an image param with a placeholder.
